name: SHS Holdings Ltd.
summary: SHS Holdings Ltd., established in Singapore in 1971, operates as an investment holding company with a broad presence across Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia, the People's Republic of China, Australia, and New Zealand. Its primary business revolves around specialized grit blasting and painting services. The company's operations are categorized into distinct divisions: The Engineering & Construction division specializes in the design, engineering, and erection of structures fabricated from steel, aluminum, and glass. This segment also provides comprehensive design and building services, including significant upgrading initiatives. The Corrosion Prevention segment delivers crucial protective solutions, involving abrasive blasting and the application of coatings to various raw materials such as steel plates, structural components (like beams and pipes), and pre-fabricated modules. Its services extend to grit blasting and internal paint application for chemical tankers, barges, and Floating, Production, Storage, and Offloading (FPSO) vessels, catering to the marine, offshore oil and gas, civil engineering, and infrastructure sectors. This division also performs on-site blasting and coating for ship hulls, oil rigs, and FPSO modules or structures. Moreover, it is involved in the design, supply, and distribution of diverse corrosion prevention systems, related machinery, equipment, materials, products, and specialized blasting and painting apparatus. The Solar Energy segment encompasses the entire lifecycle of solar power projects, from engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) to project development. It also offers energy-efficient lighting solutions, provides electrical supply and installation for lighting and induction lamps in commercial and industrial settings, and undertakes the design and installation of air conditioning and mechanical ventilation systems for residential, industrial, and commercial users. The Trading of Commodities segment focuses on the promotion and sale of metals and aluminum-related products. Finally, the Others segment comprises property development, warehousing services, investment activities, and delivers engineering and project management expertise for electrical works. The company was previously known as See Hup Seng Limited before rebranding to SHS Holdings Ltd. in October 2014.
